verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a documentation framework, and docs tooling could plausibly ship an AI agent that drafts, updates, or reviews docs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only MDX authoring, plugins, versioning, i18n, search, and build/deploy. Nothing shows a platform agent that writes or reviews docs from a prompt, PR, or schedule, or that opens change requests, and the probes found no AI-oriented surfaces such as llms.txt.
